We are seeking  Machine Learning Engineers to lead high-impact research projects that bridge the gap between state-of-the-art AI and production-grade financial systems. You will be responsible for solving complex, ambiguous problems using Deep Learning and Foundation Models, ensuring our architectures are scalable, efficient, and driving measurable business results.

As an Machine Learning Engineer (MLE), you’re expected to:

 1. Research Execution & Technical Leadership (Complexity & Autonomy)

 - Lead and execute complex applied research initiatives independently, focusing on building and optimizing architectures (e.g., Transformers, GNNs) that can be deployed across critical use cases like Credit, RecSys, GenAI, and real-time inference.

 - Address difficult and ambiguous modeling problems that require coordination across various stakeholders (Data, Infra, Product), delivering innovative solutions with a clear focus on medium-term impact.

 - Bridge the gap between research and production by designing architectures that respect MLOps constraints, ensuring models are optimized for latency, interpretability, and cost-efficiency.

 1. Strategic Impact & Collaboration (Impact)

 - Develop and deliver innovative solutions that address project-level challenges, focusing on pushing the latest platform and AI research improvements into downstream production models.

 - Actively participate in cross-functional collaborations, ensuring that research outputs are seamlessly integrated into Nubank's decision-making engines.

 - Establish technical standards within the AI Core team for experimentation, model evaluation, and code quality, inspiring peers to raise their performance.

 1. Mentorship & Function Contribution (Function Contribution)

 - Serve as a technical mentor for senior engineers and researchers, providing guidance on deep learning fundamentals, problem formulation, and research methodology.

 - Actively contribute to the function's growth by participating in mandatory activities like hiring (interview panels) and leading internal task forces to improve our ML lifecycle.

 - Contribute to thought leadership by participating in research collaborations or internal papers that align with Nubank’s strategic goals.

What are we looking for?

 - Professional Experience: 5-7+ years in applied AI/ML, with a proven track record of delivering research-driven systems into production environments

 - Technical Mastery:
   
   - Deep expertise in Deep Learning architectures (Transformers, Multimodal, or GNNs).

   - Solid understanding of MLOps and the constraints of deploying models at scale.

 - Problem Solving: Sophisticated skills in ML problem formulation and the ability to navigate uncertainty when data is messy or unavailable.

 - Communication: Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical peers and cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring alignment and buy-in.

 - Analytical Capacity: Experience with large-scale experimentation and A/B testing to validate research hypotheses.

Our Benefits

ABOUT NU

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog https://building.nubank.com.br and get some insights into how we work.

 

As a Business Analyst, you’re expected to:

 - Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;

 - Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;

 - Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available; Use tools like SQL, Python, Databricks and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;

 - Understand our products and interactions with other areas;

 - Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;

 - Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

 What are we looking for?

 - Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;

 - Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);

 - Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;

 - Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;

 - Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;

 - Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;

 - Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;

 - Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture.

Core Benefits

 - Chance of earning equity at Nu

 - Extended maternity and paternity leaves

 - Health and life insurance

 - NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

 - Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

 - NuLanguage - Our language learning program

 - Vacations of 17 workdays with 25% vacation bonus

 - Gym partnership

 - Dental and Vision Insurance

 - Holiday Bonus ("Aguinaldo") of 30 days of pay per year

 - Food card

 - Work-from-home Allowance

 - Parental Consultancy

 - Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Mexico City, MX

ESTAMOS BUSCANDO PROFISSIONAIS QUE

 - Sejam pessoas com deficiência (PcD);

 - Conhecimento prático em linguagens de programação para backend;

 - Prática em frameworks utilizados no desenvolvimento de backend;

Nubank is not just entering the US market — we are already here. For some years already we have a fully operational US C-corporation, with tax filing obligations across 13+ states, a growing engineering and technology workforce hub and a banking license on the horizon. We are on the threshold of becoming a bank in the United States, and you will be at the center of it all.

This role is for a builder — someone who doesn't just execute processes but creates them. You will be the first internal Tax professional embedded in the US, responsible for internalizing a function that is currently managed entirely through external advisors. You will design the governance framework, establish the controls, and define what US tax looks like at Nubank for years to come.

You will work directly with global leadership and a world-class external advisory team, with the full weight of a NYSE-listed company behind you and the agility of a startup in front of you. Few roles offer the rare combination of technical depth, structural authority, and the chance to genuinely leave your mark on a company at a defining moment in its trajectory.

If you are a seasoned US tax professional who wants to build, not just maintain — this is your role.



YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Your day-to-day will be defined by the dynamism of a complex, fast-growing financial operation. As the first US Tax hire, your main challenges and activities will include:

 -  Internal Function Setup: Transitioning from an outsourced model to an in-house function by building processes, controls, governance standards, and documentation frameworks from the ground up. 
   • Compliance and Ancillary Obligations: Managing the full tax compliance cycle and ensuring the timely delivery of federal, state, and international tax filings (such as Forms 1120, 5471, 8858, 8865, FBAR/FATCA, and indirect taxes).

Essential experience

 - Financial institution tax compliance: You’ve prepared and reviewed tax filings in a regulated financial services environment, with familiarity with bank-specific considerations (bad debt reserves, OID) and information reporting obligations (Forms 1099, 1042, FATCA/CRS).

 - Tax project management: Experience coordinating transfer pricing studies, preparing or reviewing IRC §482 documentation, and interfacing with external law firms and Big Four advisors on strategic, time-sensitive deliverables.

Hands-on proficiency with tax compliance and provision software (Corptax, OneSource, or Bloomberg Tax) and the ability to use ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) to extract, reconcile, and analyze large volumes of tax data.

vacantes.description:
ABOUT NU

HEAD OF DESIGN (HANDS-ON), DIGITAL ASSETS

We are building open money and open financial services — not "crypto."

The Digital Assets team at Nubank is reimagining how a financial services platform can use blockchain technology to solve real problems for real people — without ever making customers think about the blockchain at all. We have deliberately renamed ourselves from Crypto to Digital Assets, and we have effectively banned the word "crypto" internally. We do not do crypto for crypto's sake. We do blockchain banking.

The reference point is Apple Pay. It runs on cryptography, public and private keys, and secure tokenization inside a secure enclave. Apple never says any of that. It says "on device," and "it just works." That is the standard for everything we ship.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on design leader to join the Digital Assets team in Palo Alto. You will be the lead design voice for a genuinely new category: making digital assets — Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and stablecoins — as simple, accessible, and trusted as a debit card swipe.

This role sits at the intersection of consumer product design, financial innovation, and zero-to-one invention. Much of what you will design has never existed in consumer form before. You will not be asked to study what the incumbents did; the explicit instruction is to carve a new path.




WHAT YOU WILL DESIGN

 - The buy, hold, and sell experience for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Digital Dollars, etc. — designed to feel intuitive, familiar, and clear from the first interaction.

 - Earning, also known as staking: an experience that lets customers put eligible digital assets to work and earn rewards with clarity, control, and trust — without exposing the protocol mechanics underneath.

 - Onchain transfers and payments: sending, receiving, and using digital assets in ways that feel as simple and dependable as moving money today, while the underlying blockchain complexity stays out of the customer’s way.

 - The invisible infrastructure layer that powers core functionality across the entire company, including the US build.

 - Both the customer experience and the platform that other teams will draw on for future launches.

 - New ways for people to own, move, use, and grow value across financial products and borders — shaping a flexible foundation for what open money can become without being constrained by today’s conventions.




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - Consumer instincts over crypto fluency. Deep domain experience in crypto is not the point here — and can even work against you. If your instinct is to explain custody models or gas fees to a customer, this is not the seat.

 - Mobile expertise is a must-have. There is no desktop app in Brazil; effectively no web. Strong recent mobile work is non-negotiable, and a primarily B2B or enterprise background is a hard fit.

 - Zero-to-one experience. You have designed products that did not exist before, where there were no references to copy, and you thrived in the ambiguity.

 - A product marketing mindset. You care about the words, the positioning, and how it feels — not just the design elements. Our touchstone is "a thousand songs in your pocket," decided before the product was designed.

 - The ability to hide complexity. You have made something complicated feel obvious and delightful. Products that resonate with us: Cash App, Apple, the Tesla app, Duolingo, Wise, Revolut.

 - Fintech experience

ABOUT THE TEAM

This is a build role. Nubank is standing up its first Global Creative & Brand Foundations Center of Excellence (CoE): a central hub sets best practices, capacity planning, and quality measurement, while markets retain execution. You'll be defining the operating model as you go, in close partnership with Senior Leadership and the regional creative leadership.

The mandate is specific: Brand Foundations and the Creative Center of Excellence. Own the craft and brand disciplines globally and Execution stays local. Brand Foundations is a small, Brazil-based team (currently three to four people) that has owned Nubank's brand refresh, sonic identity, and institutional design system; Nubank's institutional brand work globally is also moving into this role's remit. Your job is to build the system, standards, career paths, hiring bar, tooling, and review cadence, that lets creative and brand quality hold as Nubank multiplies markets and headcount.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This role owns Brand and Creative globally for Nubank — not an advisory function reviewing guidelines from the sidelines, but full, end-to-end accountability for how the brand shows up everywhere Nubank operates.

The mandate centers on two things:

 - Setting the creative and brand bar. Define what "great" looks like concretely enough that regional teams can hold themselves to it, rather than relying on a single senior reviewer to catch problems after the fact.

 - Building the infrastructure behind great creative work — tooling, review cadence, and governance — so quality can scale without linear headcount growth.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Hiring bar & talent. Set and protect the hiring bar for creative talent in every market where Nubank hires. Recruit senior creative leaders and stay closely involved in senior creative hires as the Center of Excellence builds out. Coach and seniorize existing creative talent over time, particularly in Brazil.

 - Scalable tooling. Build the tools and workflows — including AI-assisted ones — that let creative quality scale without linear headcount growth.

 - Review cadence & governance. Run a structured, content-focused creative review cadence that replaces today's ad hoc, adversarial feedback loops between markets and leadership.

 - Creative direction beyond the traditional campaign. Push the creative product past efficiency-driven, format-first advertising toward earned media and content built to be genuinely watched, not just placed.

Core Workstreams

 1. Brand Foundations — Own brand refresh, sonic identity, and the institutional design system, plus Nubank's institutional brand presence company-wide, in close partnership with Cristina Junqueira.

 2. Creative Center of Excellence — Own creative output company-wide: campaigns, social content, influencer marketing, and marketing stunts. Set the creative and brand bar that lets regional teams hold themselves to a consistent standard — distinct from media planning and channel measurement, which remain with regional teams.

 3. Creative Production & Agency Management — Build an in-house production capability and direct the roster of external creative agencies.


QUALIFICATIONS

Professional Experience & Education

 - 10+ years in creative or brand leadership, with a track record of setting standards across multiple markets or business units — not just producing work for one.

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to drive the overarching strategy, technical vision, and execution across Nubank’s Quality & Developer Experience ecosystem. You will sit at the epicenter of our engineering transformation.

This role goes far beyond traditional quality assurance or testing; you will own the end-to-end (E2E) Developer Experience (DevEx) across the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). From internal developer platform tools and boundary APIs to our suite of testing mechanisms and automated code reviews, your mission will be to architect AI-native systems that drastically reduce review latency, guarantee architectural correctness, and double engineering productivity across Nubank.   Working alongside our most tenured engineering leaders and reporting into platform leadership, you will serve as the technical authority who brings fresh, market-leading perspectives from high-velocity environments to elevate our foundational standards.



Mission
Architect, scale, and operationalize an AI-transformed Developer Experience & Quality strategy so that:

 - The "Secure and Quality Path" is the Default: Automated mechanisms, linting, and smart context-aware agents enforce strict architectural standards, eliminating code quality degradation caused by high-volume AI code generation.

 - Developer Velocity Doubles (2x): The friction in review latency, pull request (PR) approvals, and continuous integration is systematically dismantled, enabling thousands of engineers to ship features safely to 140M+ customers at unprecedented speeds.

 - SDLC is Re-imagined for AI: Foundational tools across code authorship, testing, boundary APIs, and PR reviews are seamlessly integrated with state-of-the-art AI frameworks, smart LLM evaluations, and context-engineering hooks.

 - Automated Approval Standards are Built: Clear deterministic checks and intelligent human-in-the-loop triggers are established to achieve safe, automated PR approvals without manual bottlenecks.



Core Responsibilities

 - Architect E2E Quality & DevEx Platforms: Define and evolve the multi-year vision for our developer tooling ecosystem—covering internal developer platforms, boundary APIs, test automation suites, and pull request review systems.

 - Lead the AI-Driven Code Review Evolution: Architect automated review mechanisms that leverage multi-model evaluations (e.g., using specialized LLMs to audit generated code), custom IDE/GitHub plugins, and deterministic linting to accelerate PR merge times while preventing code bloat or quality degradation.

 - Define Human-in-the-Loop Boundaries: Set company-wide paradigms for when code changes can be automatically approved and merged versus when human intervention or secondary AI audits are required.

 - Partner & Mentor Across Engineering: Act as a force multiplier by partnering with engineers and product managers, elevating the technical bar and instilling modern, high-velocity DevEx practices.

 - Balance AI Speed with System Integrity: Establish observability, defect-tracking metrics, and safety rails to ensure that rapid AI-assisted development does not introduce structural fragility into Nubank's core services.

 - Influence Build vs. Buy Strategy: Evaluate top-tier market tools, AI coding frameworks, and internal platforms to decide when to build bespoke internal agents or integrate emerging third-party tooling.

About the role
As Nubank scales its footprint globally, seamless international money movement is a cornerstone of our growth. We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own the overarching architecture for Nubank’s global Remittance and Cross-Border Payment Platforms. In this role, you will sit at the strategic intersection of high-scale distributed backend systems, foreign exchange (FX) engines, international payment rails, and global compliance platforms. You won't just maintain existing pipelines, you will architect the foundation that enables instant, low-cost, multi-currency money movement for millions of users across borders.Your mission: maintain and grow a resilient, multi-country remittance engine that abstracts away complex global payment rails and regulatory requirements into simple, reliable platform capabilities.



What You Will Own & Build

 - Core Remittance Platform Architecture: Design and evolve the long-term technical vision for multi-currency money movement, FX rate locking, payout routing, and ledgering across international corridors.

 - Global Rail Integration Strategy: Architect plug-and-play integrations with global payout partners, banking networks, and local clearing rails (e.g., PIX, SPEI, FedNow, SWIFT) with ultra-high reliability and low latencies.

 - Resilient Ledgering & FX Management: Build transaction execution engines that guarantee exact-once delivery, deterministic ledger balancing, real-time liquidity management, and auditability under massive concurrency.

 - Compliance & Risk System Abstractions: Partner with AML, KYC, Sanctions Screening, and Regulatory Engineering teams to embed real-time screening seamlessly into payment paths without degrading user experience or throughput.

 - Technical RFC Leadership: Drive cross-organizational consensus on high-impact architectural decisions through detailed RFCs, design reviews, and technical documentation.

 - Engineering Mentorship: Multiply organizational velocity by mentoring senior engineers across payments squads in distributed systems principles, resilience engineering, and payment domain knowledge.



What We Are Looking For

 - Tenure in Backend Software Engineering: Proven track record of designing, operating, and scaling highly available, mission-critical backend distributed platforms in demanding environments (e.g., fintech, payments, banking, or cloud platform infrastructure).

 - Deep Payments Domain Expertise: Hands-on experience building remittance systems, cross-border payments, multi-currency ledger engines, FX execution services, or integrations with international payment clearing systems.

 - Distributed Systems Mastery: High fluency with event-driven architectures, transactional consistency, distributed sagas/orchestration, double-entry accounting engines, and high-concurrency microservices.

 - Platform Mindset: Experience designing clean, developer-friendly APIs, SDKs, and platform boundaries that enable product teams to quickly launch consumer-facing remittance journeys.

 - Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to act as a horizontal technical leader, writing comprehensive design documents (RFCs), guiding executive leadership on technical trade-offs, and building consensus across geographically distributed teams.

 - Language & Location: Fluent English is required for international engineering collaboration. Portuguese or Spanish is a plus. Roles are open in Brazil (hybrid model)

The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer — which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it.

Canonicalizing what already exists. Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds.

You will: Build AI-powered prospecting & SDR tooling: design and ship agents/workflows that find, qualify, and engage prospects, and that get meetings on AEs' calendars — using tools like Amplemarket, Clay, HubSpot, and LLM APIs, glued together with n8n or custom code. Own lifecycle automation end to end: build and iterate on onboarding, activation, and retention flows across email, WhatsApp, and push, using Customer.io and our internal data stack, with AI doing the heavy lifting on personalization, timing, and content generation. Design the SDR-to-AE handoff as a system, not a manual process: instrument lead scoring, routing, and handoff logic so reps spend time on conversations, not admin. Prototype fast, validate faster: you're expected to go from idea to working internal tool in days, test it against real pipeline/activation metrics, kill what doesn't work, and scale what does. Partner cross-functionally: work directly with Sales, SDR leadership, Lifecycle, and Data/Eng to identify where automation unlocks the most value, and to make sure what you build actually gets adopted. Turn data into iteration: use Metabase, HubSpot, and Customer.io data to measure what your builds are actually doing to CAC payback, meetings booked, activation rate, and pipeline generated — and report on it in plain, honest terms. Who you are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Must haves +2 years of hands-on experience building automation, internal tools, or AI-powered products — not just using AI tools, but shipping things that use APIs, LLMs, or agent frameworks to do real work. Working familiarity with CRM/lifecycle platforms such as HubSpot, Customer.io, or Salesforce. Strong written and verbal communication in English; ability to explain what you built and why it matters to non-technical stakeholders and executives. vacantes.location: Bogota / CUN / Colombia; Bogota D.C. / DC / Colombia
vacantes.description: Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others. What you'll do This is a highly hands-on design role at the intersection of growth, performance marketing, and AI. You will design the assets and experiences that drive Clara's acquisition engine across Mexico, Brazil, and Colombia — ad creatives, landing pages, lifecycle journeys, and conversion flows — using AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow, from first prompt to final asset. You'll help define what AI-augmented growth design looks like at scale, on a team that is actively building AI-native workflows into everything we do. Your responsibilities will include: Design and produce performance creative at scale — static ads, video concepts, carousels, and social assets for Meta, Google, and LinkedIn — using AI tools (e.g. Midjourney, Ideogram, Runway, Figma AI) combined with strong design craft. Design and optimize landing pages and conversion flows, applying CRO best practices for hierarchy, scroll depth, and clarity — and partnering with the Paid Media team to A/B test and iterate until the metrics move. Use AI daily to accelerate creative production: generating visual variants, exploring concepts, drafting layouts, and turning briefs into testable assets in hours, not weeks. Build and maintain a scalable creative system — templates, components, and brand-consistent asset libraries in Figma — so the Growth team ships faster across 3 markets and 3 languages (PT-BR, ES-MX, ES-CO). Partner with Growth - Paid Media to interpret creative performance data, generate hypotheses, and feed learnings back into the next iteration. Run visual QA on assets and pages before they go live; keep the brand consistent across every touchpoint of the funnel. Scout, pilot, and adopt new AI design tools — you keep our creative stack ahead of the industry, and document workflows so the whole team levels up. Use automation tools (e.g. n8n, Make, Zapier) to reduce repetitive production work and create scalable creative workflows. Who you are: Must haves: 2+ years of experience in growth design, performance/marketing design with measurable business impact. Strong portfolio demonstrating ad creatives, landing pages, or conversion-focused work — applications without a portfolio will not be considered. Active, daily user of AI tools — generative image/video tools (Midjourney, Ideogram, Runway or similar) and LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) are part of your real workflow, not an occasional experiment. Can write effective prompts: you know how to give AI models context, constraints, and references to get useful outputs on the first or second try — and you know when to take over and finish by hand. Expert in Figma; you think in components and systems, not one-offs. Conversion mindset — you track CTR, CVR, and CAC the way other designers track likes, and you use data to inform design decisions. Comfortable working with experimentation: A/B tests, creative testing frameworks, iterating based on results. Organized and able to handle multiple markets and formats in parallel. Comfortable communicating with both creative and analytical teams. Nice to haves: Experience with motion design (After Effects, Lottie, or AI-powered video tools). Experience building landing pages hands-on (Webflow, Framer, or similar). Experience with automation tools like n8n, Make, or Zapier to build creative production workflows. Experience building custom GPTs, AI agents, or AI-assisted creative pi

vacantes.title: Head of Brand & Design - Bogotá (Hybrid)
vacantes.description: Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others. About the Role We're looking for someone who gets a kick out of turning "how should Clara look and sound here?" into a shipped campaign, a visual system, or a production workflow — by next week, not next quarter. You'll define how Clara looks, sounds, and feels everywhere our customers, prospects, and candidates encounter us: product, marketing, sales materials, events, social, recruiting, and the office itself. This isn't a brand governance role. It's a build role. You'll set the visual identity and voice, create the systems that let the rest of the company ship on-brand work fast, and lead the designers, writers, and producers who bring it to life — with AI doing serious heavy lifting on production, personalization, and scale. You'll join at a stage where Clara's brand is still being defined region-wide. That means real license to shape it — and real accountability for making it distinctive, consistent, and something customers and employees are genuinely proud to be associated with. You'll report to the Head of Design and partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Clara's founders on the moments that define the brand. What You'll Do Own Clara's brand identity end to end: visual system, voice and tone, and the narrative that ties product, marketing, and culture together — and be accountable for whether it lands, not just whether it looks good. Build and lead a brand team — designers, writers, motion and production talent — recruiting exceptional people and creating the conditions for them to do their best work. Build AI-powered brand production tooling: design and ship the workflows, templates, and AI-assisted systems that let non-designers across Clara produce on-brand work without bottlenecking every asset through your team. Think prompt libraries, generative image workflows, copy scaffolding, automated asset resizing — built and iterated, not just imagined. Prototype fast, validate faster: go from brand brief to working asset or system in days, test it against real usage and perception, kill what doesn't work, and scale what does. Set up the operating rhythm for brand work — intake, briefs, reviews, approvals — so work moves quickly without sacrificing quality. Lead by making when it counts: concept development, art direction, and hands-on craft on Clara's highest-stakes brand moments — launches, campaigns, major events, the moments people remember. Partner with Product Marketing, Growth, and Sales to ensure brand shows up consistently across every customer touchpoint, from the website to the sales deck to the app itself. Partner with People and Recruiting to make Clara's employer brand as sharp and intentional as its customer-facing brand. Establish the metrics and feedback loops that show whether brand investment is working — awareness, perception, consistency, and business impact — and report on it in plain, honest terms. Who You Are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Must haves 8+ years in brand, creative, or design leadership, including experience building or scaling a brand function at a high-growth company, agency, or in-house creative team. Priorizamos ação em vez de processo. Tratamos a IA como parte central do nosso fluxo de trabalho, não como uma novidade. Nos importamos mais com o que você entregou do que com onde você estudou. Se você é o tipo de pessoa que prototipa antes de apresentar, lança antes de pedir permissão e conquista confiança por estar perto do trabalho, você vai se encaixar aqui. O que é um Product Lead? Um Product Lead é responsável pela direção de produto de um squad pequeno e autônomo. Você decide o que construir, por que isso importa e se funcionou. Você é responsável pelos resultados de negócio, não apenas pelas funcionalidades entregues. O que diferencia esse papel de um Product Manager tradicional? Você não escreve especificações e as passa adiante. Você prototipa ideias com ferramentas de IA antes de comprometer tempo de engenharia. Você contribui com código para mudanças simples (textos, configurações, feature flags, atualizações básicas de UI) para se desbloquear e avançar mais rápido. Você trabalha com Git diariamente, lê PRs e entende o que foi entregue sem precisar de reuniões de status. O trabalho principal ainda é julgamento de produto, descoberta e alinhamento com stakeholders. Porém, o nível técnico exigido é mais alto do que em um papel de PM tradicional. Você precisa se sustentar em conversas arquiteturais, conquistar a confiança da engenharia por estar próximo do trabalho e usar ferramentas de IA como parte do seu fluxo diário. Esse não é um PM que programa em tempo integral. Tampouco é um líder de engenharia com responsabilidades de produto adicionadas. É o que acreditamos ser o melhor perfil de produto na era da IA: alguém que pode ser dono dos resultados e se mover rapidamente sem esperar por handoffs. vacantes.title: AI Senior Software Engineer
vacantes.description:
About Us 
 Platzi is the largest technology school in the Hispanic world with over 7 million students and 4,000 companies trusting us to deliver effective online education. Our mission is to make Latin America a technology superpower. We do it by training companies and individuals in areas such as AI, Cybersecurity, English, Programming and Leadership.
 As an industry leader, our presence is highlighted by our massive and fanatic community, extensive press coverage and a daily stream of success stories from students. We operate mostly remote, with key offices in Bogotá, Medellín and Mexico City.
 Summary
 As a Senior Software Engineer (Learn) at Platzi you're an engineer first: you build and own systems that hold up in production, and the material you build them with is AI. Orchestration, evals, and the models behind each decision, all serving how millions of students in Latin America learn in the product. You report to the AI Lead. Seniority here means judgment, not distance from the code. You take an ambiguous problem and come back with a decision you can defend, including the decision not to build, and you care about what your code costs to run and to maintain a year from now, not only about getting it merged.
 Requirements 
 Responsibilities 
 Build AI features that ship to students, and own them in production: performance, reliability, cost, and how they recover when they break.
 Design the orchestration behind them: agents, tools and the flow between them, built to be debugged and not just demoed.
 Make evals part of how you work, so you know what improved, what regressed, and what you're trading off.
 Choose the right approach for each problem, whether that's an LLM, a classic model, or plain deterministic code.
 Make architecture decisions you can defend, and say no to complexity that doesn't pay for itself.
 Raise the bar around you through code review, standards, and the calls that stop bad decisions early.
 Requirements 
 At least 5 years building software in production, including owning a system through real scale or a migration.
 Strong fundamentals: data modeling, APIs, performance, concurrency and failure modes.
 You've taken LLM-powered systems to production, not prototypes, and you know where they broke.
 You move comfortably across frameworks like Pydantic, Agents SDK and A2A, and can explain why you chose each one.
 Experience with classic machine learning, and the judgment to know when a model beats a prompt.
 A product you built that we can see and use.
 Fluent English and Spanish.
 Benefits 
 💻 Hardware
 With Platzi's help, you will have 100% of the necessary work tools such as a laptop, smartphone, desk, ergonomic chair, monitor, and other accessories.
 📗 Books
 We provide you with all the books you need to grow professionally on Kindle, and we give you the Kindle too 😉.
 🐣 Maternity/Paternity Leave
 At Platzi, we believe in gender equity and the importance of parents in the upbringing and care of their children. We make this a reality for new mothers and fathers through extended maternity and paternity leave.
 💸 Option Pool
 All members of the Platzi Team have the opportunity to own a part of Platzi and have company shares.
 🌴 Vacation
 You have 15 days of vacation per year regardless of the country you are in, starting from the moment you join the team.
 💆‍♂️ Online Therapy
 We care about your emotional health by covering the first four online therapy sessions with specialized companies.
 🌐 Team Syncs
 Although we are in different parts of the world, Platzi teams meet in person during the year to exchange ideas, build, and strengthen bonds.
 🏖️ Villa Platzi
 Every year, the entire team gathers somewhere in the world for a week to meet face-to-face, get to know each other, have interesting discussions, and plan ambitious projects.

vacantes.description:
About DEUNA
DEUNA is a payments infrastructure platform that helps enterprise merchants across Latin America, the US, and Europe optimize and orchestrate their entire payment stack. We combine payment routing intelligence, AI-driven optimization, and a composable checkout experience to help companies increase revenue and reduce operational complexity at scale. We are backed by leading investors and processing billions of dollars in annual transaction volume.
About the Role
DEUNA is a payments infrastructure company powering enterprise commerce across Latin America, the US, and Europe. We operate at the intersection of high-volume payment orchestration and applied AI — building intelligent systems that optimize authorization rates, reduce costs, and automate complex payment workflows for some of the largest merchants in the world.
 
We are looking for a Staff/Principal-level AI Platform Tech Lead to own the full technical stack behind our AI payment intelligence and digital workforce products — from ML model training through production routing integration. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will set the architecture, write the code, and grow the team.

What You Will Do ML & AI Systems Design, train, and own the full lifecycle of ML models for payment optimization — routing decisions, authorization rate improvement, cost reduction, and fraud signals — using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or XGBoost. Build and operate LLM-powered workflows: LangGraph agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and vector DB integrations (Pinecone, pgvector, or Weaviate). Own the MLOps stack end-to-end: experiment tracking (MLflow / W&B), model registry, feature store, and automated retraining pipelines on AWS SageMaker. Monitor model health continuously — drift, distribution shifts, retraining triggers — and define evaluation metrics tied directly to business outcomes. Platform Engineering & Payments Integration Build and maintain inference services in Go and Python integrated into live payment routing — strict latency SLAs (<100 ms), zero silent errors. Own AWS infrastructure: ECS/EKS, Terraform IaC, SQS/SNS event streaming, RDS/Aurora, and S3 for model artifacts. Design and ship on-premise and hybrid deployment architectures for enterprise clients requiring local data residency, including secure data sync pipelines. Apply PCI-DSS standards across all components touching payment data; implement tokenization in ML pipelines; design for PSP-specific behavior (Cybersource, Worldpay, Prosa, Cielo, Pagbank, and others). Build and maintain RESTful and gRPC APIs that expose AI platform capabilities to merchants and partners. Technical Leadership Own observability end-to-end: Prometheus/Grafana dashboards, OpenTelemetry tracing, model-specific monitors, and on-call runbooks. Set the engineering bar for the team: architecture reviews, code standards, testing strategy (unit, integration, shadow mode), and CI/CD practices. Mentor engineers, run design reviews, and translate product vision into executable technical roadmaps with clear timelines and trade-offs. Technical Skills Backend / Platform Go (production services) Python (ML + tooling) gRPC & REST APIs Event streaming (SQS/SNS) Distributed systems Cloud & Infra — AWS ECS / EKS Terraform / IaC SageMaker or Vertex AI RDS/Aurora, S3 Hybrid / on-prem deploy AI / ML Stack PyTorch or TensorFlow XGBoost / scikit-learn MLflow / W&B Feature stores Model monitoring & drift LLMs & Agents LangGraph / LangChain RAG + vector DBs Prompt engineering LLM evaluation Structured outputs Payments Domain PCI-DSS compliance Tokenization patterns PSP integrations Auth rate optimization Routing orchestration Frontend React / Next.js TypeScript Component systems API integration Observability Prometheus / Grafana OpenTelemetry Structured logging On-call runbooks Data SQL (analytical) Airflow / dbt Feature pipelines Data quality & lineage What We Are Looking For 8+ years in software engineering; 3+ at Staff, Principal, or Tech Lead level own

Instrument before you build — decide the metric and the dashboard up front; correlation IDs that survive every async hop; alerts that mean something. Corporate IT Manager
This role is open only to candidates based in India. Applications from outside India will not be considered.
Who We Are
Yuno is the AI-native operating system of global commerce, powering the financial infrastructure of enterprise merchants, banks, and wallets. Through a single API, Yuno connects them to pay-ins, payouts, fraud prevention, KYC/KYB, and stablecoins globally, so they can operate everywhere. Agnostic by design and connected to 1,000+ payment methods and 460+ integrations in 190+ countries, Yuno optimizes acceptance rates, reduces costs, and strengthens security through specialized AI agents that learn from every transaction. Global brands including McDonald's, NetEase Games, GoFundMe, and Rappi run their payments on Yuno.
About The Role
Yuno is looking for a Corporate IT Manager, based in India, to own the internal technology backbone that keeps our fully remote, global team productive and secure. From device management and identity to SaaS administration and compliance, you'll lead Corporate IT, a new area within our Tech Infrastructure team, designing systems and automation that scale as Yuno grows across 190+ countries.
This is not a helpdesk role. You'll own the corporate IT stack end to end, drive the roadmap, automate what others still do by hand, and make security and compliance a built-in default rather than an afterthought — which matters when the company runs payments for global brands. You'll work closely with our Security team, taking corporate IT workload off SecOps, and you'll build and lead the Corporate IT team as it grows.
How AI Shows Up in This Role
You'll build AI-driven automation for IT and helpdesk, turning repetitive requests and lifecycle workflows into self-serve flows, and maintain machine-readable documentation that AI assistants can act on
As an AI-native company, Yuno runs on a growing stack of AI tools — you'll own how they're provisioned, secured, and governed across the org, managing access and OAuth/shadow-AI risk. And you're encouraged to use AI to move faster in your own work
Your Contribution Will Be
Corporate IT ownership and roadmap — own the corporate IT function end to end and drive the corporate IT roadmap as the company scales
Device and endpoint management — own the MDM platform (Jamf, Intune, or Kandji) for a distributed macOS and Windows fleet: zero-touch provisioning, patching, configuration-as-code, and endpoint security
Identity and access management — administer the identity provider (Okta or equivalent), SSO, MFA, and SCIM; automate onboarding and offboarding, and enforce least-privilege access across every system
SaaS administration and governance — manage the SaaS stack (Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and more), rein in shadow IT and OAuth risk, and right-size licenses and access
Security and compliance — build and maintain the controls, access reviews, and audit evidence that keep Yuno compliant (SOC 2, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), partnering with Security on vendor reviews
Automation — replace manual work with scripting and workflow automation (Python, Okta Workflows, or similar)
Team leadership and enablement — act as the senior escalation point for complex IT issues, maintain clear runbooks and documentation, and lead and mentor the Corporate IT team as it grows
What Success Looks Like
Within your first 6–12 months, onboarding and offboarding run end to end without manual steps, the device fleet and SaaS access are fully managed and auditable, and SOC 2 and PCI evidence is something the team produces continuously rather than scrambling for at audit time.

Minimum Qualifications
5+ years in corporate IT, IT operations, or IT systems engineering, ideally supporting a distributed workforce
Experience managing or mentoring IT team members, or leading corporate IT for a team or company
Based in India, with the right to work in India
MDM expertise — hands-on

If you are technically sharp, and genuinely excited about building something meaningful in one of the most dynamic payment markets in the world — this role is for you.

Work cross-functionally with Sales, Partnerships, and Finance to support account retention and regional growth

Champion the LATAM customer base internally, bringing regional intelligence into Yuno's strategic conversations
